title: ReportRequested
description: Asks the report builder to (re)build one report at one version. Written to the outbox by the aggregator (monthly reports made stale, months that got their first covered day, reports a reader is waiting for) and by the reports API (a stale report was viewed). Topic: spendly.report-requested, key: reportId. Consumer: report builder (group spendly-backend-report-builder). The builder saves its result only while reports.version still equals `version`, so an older request never overwrites a newer build (AC-TX-3).

accountScope.description: ALL (every account, the combined view) or the sorted, comma-separated account IDs

reason.description: STALE_MONTHLY: a monthly report became stale (rebuilt eagerly). MONTH_STARTED: a month got its first covered day. STALE_VIEWED: someone opened a stale report. PENDING_REBUILD: data changed while a build was running
